candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, the method only sets the new password and updates the user. It never deletes the user's existing sessions. Refresh tokens are validated against session records (refreshToken uses sessionService.updateByHash), so a device that was already signed in keeps a valid session and can still renew its login after the reset.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, delete all of the user's sessions by calling `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });`.
